correctness.rationale: The ruler-word identity Z_n[p]=a_{1+nu2(p)} implies any factor has a unique occurrence of its largest-ranked symbol; any occurrence has fixed right endpoint residue modulo 2^r. Therefore each endpos equivalence class is E_{r,j}, earliest end position p in [2^(r-1),2^r-1]. Right extensions are exactly consecutive ruler letters or transitions from block ends to first a_s positions, establishing the explicit graph. Each p is reachable by the prefix ending at p; distinct states have different maximal continuation lengths N-p for factors, and different maximal suffix-completion lengths for the suffix language, proving both minimalities. Counts follow by counting consecutive prefix-path arcs and extra block-end arcs. Independently enumerated all substrings, complete end-position classes, suffix acceptances and labelled arcs for ranks 1 through 6; verifier code uses an independent classical suffix-automaton construction up to rank 11.
residual_risks: The finite enumeration verifies only ranks <=6; unrestricted statement follows from ruler/endpos proof.
Complete DFAs add one rejecting sink; suffixes/factors are literal words on n distinct symbols, not Zimin morphic pattern instances.

value.rationale: The exact minimal automaton of a canonical recursive word family is a natural invariant. The ruler-map provides a succinct O(n)-bit state representation for an exponentially sized automaton, and the per-symbol arc law contains more information than the pre-existing integer sequence or membership algorithm.
residual_risks: Does not improve worst-case complexity of the known literal-factor membership algorithm; no claim for morphic Zimin-pattern instances.

final_claim: For rank-n finite literal Zimin words Z_n with 2^n-1 letters, an explicit ruler-arithmetic partial DFA with 2^n states is simultaneously the minimal factor automaton (all states final) and minimal suffix automaton (only 0 and block-end states final); reading a factor reaches its first occurrence end position. Exact label-s transition counts are 2^(n-s)+s-1 and total transitions 2^n-1+n(n-1)/2 for every n>=1.
